interpretation: Policy ACCEPT is not equivalent to adjudicated VALID.
Known calibration and held-out labels are applied even when the frozen policy action was ACCEPT.
The 415 NEW_PRODUCTION ACCEPT pairs without individual adjudication retain their frozen policy status and are explicitly marked unadjudicated.
UNCERTAIN remains distinct from INVALID and is held separately.
Operational inclusion of an unadjudicated policy ACCEPT does not constitute a claim of human-validated correctness.
The frozen A2 routing rule is not retuned from these adjudication outcomes.
This artifact concerns the A2 marginal candidate universe only and does not validate the global A1 baseline.
